homepage markup and contact form endpoint

observations.after_signature: Mobile shows the same headline family, compact split controls, phone action and full form inside the responsive panel.
observations.observed_visible_result: No horizontal overflow or clipped controls observed; the phone action is present on mobile.

verification.live_browser: Codex in-app browser opened local /scenario/ and captured desktop/mobile popup states
verification.messenger_scope: Deep-link values were preserved and inspected only; no Telegram/MAX bot session was opened.
